scripts.video: node scripts/ensure-browser.mjs && remotion render src/index.ts Clip build/silent.mp4
scripts.mux: mkdir -p out && ffmpeg -y -loglevel error -i build/silent.mp4 -i build/narration.wav -filter_complex "[1:a]adelay=500:all=1,apad[a]" -map 0:v -map "[a]" -c:v copy -c:a aac -b:a 192k -t 5 out/clip.mp4 && rm build/silent.mp4
scripts.build: npm run narrate && npm run video && npm run mux
scripts.kit:still: node scripts/ensure-browser.mjs && remotion still src/index.ts KitPreview
